channel.title: Long Island Business News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Long Island Business News (libn.com)

item.title: LI leaders unite to bring Sunrise Wind to finish line
item.description: Long Island officials urge BOEM to lift Sunrise Wind suspension, citing union jobs, economic growth and clean offshore energy benefits.

item.title: Tracking Ethereum’s Evolution: What You Should Know
item.description: The Ethereum price is currently trading in the $2,250–$3,000 USD range, but understanding its movement requires more than tracking market sentiment alone.

item.title: LI architecture firm transforms Valley Stream school library
item.description: A newly renovated library has opened at Howell Road Elementary in Valley Stream, featuring flexible learning spaces designed by MDS Architecture.

item.title: United Way of Long Island names new board leaders
item.description: United Way of Long Island announces new board leadership and members, bringing expertise in finance, healthcare, education and community service

item.title: Construction employment on Long Island continues to slide
item.description: Long Island construction employment fell 8% year over year in December, losing 6,300 jobs as contractor demand slows, according to AGCA data.

item.title: LI community health centers urge state funding boost
item.description: Long Island community health centers are urging New York lawmakers to increase funding, protect 340B and ensure telehealth parity

item.title: $29.6M Southampton redevelopment project getting IDA assist
item.description: The $29.6M Southampton redevelopment would add a 40-unit all-suite hotel, workforce housing and more.

item.title: New grants for Suffolk arts and historic sites aim to boost tourism
item.description: Discover Long Island announced $5K–$35K grants to arts, historic sites and cultural organizations in Suffolk County to boost tourism and community engagement

item.title: LI coffee maker expands with bottled cold brew for retail
item.description: Long Island-based So Brew’d is expanding with bottled cold brew now sold at select retailers, while continuing coffee carts, pop-ups and subscriptions.

item.title: Farmingdale State launches new applied physics bachelor’s program
item.description: Farmingdale State College introduces a BS in applied physics, preparing students for high-tech careers and advanced research opportunities.
